stage_one: RF and IF agree, and RF probability <= 0.2 or >= 0.8: accept RF
stage_two: Otherwise invoke BiLSTM and GraphSAGE and use the majority of RF, BiLSTM and GraphSAGE decisions at their frozen individual thresholds
edge_condition: Every stage-two window is an LLM candidate, including IF disagreement or RF uncertainty
budget_order: ascending SHA256 of sample_id; independent of labels, source and errors
fallback: Preserve the stage-two majority on budget exhaustion, timeout, invalid JSON or unsupported label
enable_rule: Enable overriding only if Validation cascade plus LLM has FPR <= 1% and F1 >= cascade F1 and at least one valid response; otherwise retain local LLM as an evaluated shadow arbitrator
score: Cascade decisions are binary operational scores, not calibrated probabilities; LLM override scores are likewise binary
